svg.title: KINGMAKER weekly cycle — three schedule options compared
svg.desc: Three weekly schedule options for KINGMAKER 23:23 plotted on a Sun-to-Sat timeline, showing receipt window, bell strike, and announcement times.

g.text: Option B — your new proposal (Wed 23:23 start)
All three options use JST/KST (UTC+9). 24:00 = midnight = next day 00:00.
"Fri 23:22 close" + "Fri 23:23 ring" = literally back-to-back. Option B+C are dramaturgically tight.
